# Public methods that need no wire case because they send no request, which
# TestEveryPublicMethodHasAWireCase (wirecases_test.go) reads. Each line names a method as
# <Type>.<Method>, such as UsersService.WaitForSync, then a space and the reason it needs no wire
# case. Blank lines and lines that start with # are ignored. A line without a reason, a line that
# names no public method and a line that names a method with a wire case fail the test.

Client.Close closes the client's own idle connections; it sends no request
Client.Format prints the client's settings; it sends no request
Client.GoString prints the client's settings; it sends no request
Client.LogValue gives slog the client's settings; it sends no request
Client.String prints the client's settings; it sends no request
TenantsService.WaitForSync returns a copy of the service; it sends no request
UsersService.WaitForSync returns a copy of the service; it sends no request
